name: step-race
description: A weekly step-count race for a group of ten, on Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute step-race --local --command "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cheers; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS auth_throttle; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS password_resets; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS step_entries; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS meta;" && npm run db:init
